where the Government servant has no family. If no nomination has been made or the nomination made by the Government servant does not subsist, the ex gratia lumpsum compensation will be shared equally by all eligible family members, as in the case of Gratuity, in accordance with Rule 47 of the CCS (Pension) Rules.
